title: CTP® Certification (Certified Treasury Professional)
source: AFP Treasury Learning System & CTP Test Specifications
summary: The benchmark global credential for corporate treasury management, cash positioning, working capital optimization, payment systems, and financial risk mitigation across 5 core domains and 2 years experience.

standard.name: Standard Corporate Treasury Track
standard.blurb: Pass the 170-question examination (scaled score 500/800) and verify 2 years of professional corporate treasury or cash management experience.

stages.title: Stage 1: Treasury Operations, Cash Management & Payment Systems
stages.subtitle: Domains 1, 2, and 3: Operations, Cash/Liquidity, and Payments

nodes.name: Domain 1: Treasury Operations & Controls
nodes.description: Treasury management systems (TMS), bank relationship management, bank compensation/account analysis, internal controls, and disaster recovery.
topics: Treasury Management System (TMS) Architecture & SWIFT Connectivity
Bank Relationship Management, RFPs & Account Analysis Statements (EDI 822)
Treasury Internal Controls, Fraud Prevention & Segregation of Duties

nodes.name: Domain 2: Cash and Liquidity Management
nodes.description: Daily cash positioning, cash forecasting models (receipts and disbursements), cash concentration, notional pooling, physical sweeping, and short-term investing/borrowing.
topics: Daily Cash Positioning & Short-Term Liquidity Forecasting Models
Cash Concentration Structures: Zero-Balance Accounts (ZBAs), Notional Pooling, Sweeping
Short-Term Investment Portfolios (Commercial Paper, Repos, MMFs) & Credit Lines

nodes.name: Domain 3: Payment Systems and Technology
nodes.description: Electronic payment networks (Fedwire, CHIPS, ACH, SEPA), real-time payments (RTP, FedNow), ISO 20022 messaging, card networks, and payment fraud prevention.
topics: Wholesale Wire Transfer Systems (Fedwire, CHIPS) vs ACH Batch Processing
Cross-Border Payments, SEPA & ISO 20022 Financial Messaging Standards
Instant Payment Systems (FedNow, RTP) & Corporate Blockchain Settlements

stages.title: Stage 2: Working Capital, Capital Markets & Comprehensive Exam
stages.subtitle: Domains 4 & 5 + 170-Question Pearson VUE CBT Exam

nodes.name: Domain 4: Working Capital Management
nodes.description: Cash Conversion Cycle (CCC), trade credit terms, accounts receivable optimization, lockbox systems, supply chain finance, and accounts payable automation.
topics: Cash Conversion Cycle (DSO, DPO, DIO) Calculation and Optimization
Collections Systems: Wholesale/Retail Lockboxes & Electronic Billing
Supply Chain Finance, Dynamic Discounting & Reverse Factoring

nodes.name: Domain 5: Financial Risk Management & Capital Markets
nodes.description: Foreign exchange risk management (transaction, translation, economic), interest rate swaps, commodity hedging, capital structure, debt covenants, and credit ratings.
topics: Foreign Exchange Exposure Identification & Hedging with Forwards/Options
Interest Rate Risk Management: Swaps, Caps, Floors & Collars
Long-Term Debt Financing: Bonds, Syndicated Loans & Credit Ratings Agencies

nodes.name: CTP Computer-Based Examination
nodes.description: 170-question examination administered globally via Pearson VUE. Passing standard: scaled score of 500 out of 800 points.

nodes.name: 2 Years Corporate Treasury Experience
nodes.description: Demonstrate at least 2 years of full-time professional work experience in cash management, corporate treasury, banking, or corporate finance.
topics: 24 Months Corporate Treasury Verification
Supervisory Attestation

nodes.name: Certified Treasury Professional Conferred & Ethics
nodes.description: Official award of the Certified Treasury Professional (CTP®) credential. Requires 36 approved recertification credits every 3 years and adherence to AFP ethics.
topics: CTP Credential Award
36 Recertification Credits every 3 Years
AFP Standards of Ethical Conduct
